partners.diseaseBName: Mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial diseases due to partial STAT1 deficiency
partners.mechanism_chain: STAT1 (HGNC:11100) —DISRUPTS→ JAK-STAT signaling pathway (WP:WP464); JAK-STAT signaling pathway (WP:WP464) —LEADS_TO→ Increased susceptibility to mycobacterial infections (HP:0002711); IL21R (HGNC:27073) —DISRUPTS→ IL-21 signaling pathway (WP:WP504); IL-21 signaling pathway (WP:WP504) —INCREASES→ JAK-STAT signaling pathway (WP:WP464); JAK-STAT signaling pathway (WP:WP464) —LEADS_TO→ Immunodeficiency (HP:0002705). Both IL21R deficiency (Disease A) and STAT1 deficiency (Disease B) impair downstream immune signaling pathways. STAT1 is a critical transcription factor in the JAK-STAT pathway, which is also influenced by IL-21 signaling. Dysfunction in STAT1 directly impairs this pathway, leading to immunodeficiency and susceptibility to infections. IL-21 signaling also converges on and enhances STAT1-mediated responses. Therefore, defects in either IL21R or STAT1 can lead to a common downstream impairment of immune cell function and a shared phenotype of immunodeficiency.
partners.mechanism_narrative: STAT1 (HGNC:11100) —DISRUPTS→ JAK-STAT signaling pathway (WP:WP464); JAK-STAT signaling pathway (WP:WP464) —LEADS_TO→ Increased susceptibility to mycobacterial infections (HP:0002711); IL21R (HGNC:27073) —DISRUPTS→ IL-21 signaling pathway (WP:WP504); IL-21 signaling pathway (WP:WP504) —INCREASES→ JAK-STAT signaling pathway (WP:WP464); JAK-STAT signaling pathway (WP:WP464) —LEADS_TO→ Immunodeficiency (HP:0002705). STAT1 is a critical transcription factor in the JAK-STAT pathway, which is also influenced by IL-21 signaling. Dysfunction in STAT1 directly impairs this pathway, leading to immunodeficiency and susceptibility to infections. IL-21 signaling also converges on and enhances STAT1-mediated responses. Therefore, defects in either IL21R or STAT1 can lead to a common downstream impairment of immune cell function and a shared phenotype of immunodeficiency.

falsification.text: If genetic studies reveal that the causal variants for Disease A (IL21R deficiency) and Disease B (STAT1 deficiency) act through entirely independent and non-overlapping downstream signaling cascades, and do not converge on shared immune cell populations or functions, this hypothesis would be falsified. For example, if STAT1 deficiency primarily affects T-cell differentiation while IL21R deficiency exclusively impacts B-cell activation in a manner not involving STAT1, the link would be weak.
falsification.gnomad_variant: The presence of common variants in STAT1 (e.g., rs1049060) with frequencies >1% in gnomAD that do not segregate with Disease B would weaken the direct causal link for STAT1 dysfunction.
